ar: سُبْحَانَ اللّٰهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ وَلَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَاللّٰهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيْمِ حَسْبِيَ اللّٰهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ ـ سَبْعًا
tr: Subḥāna ‘lLāhi wa ‘l-ḥamdu li ‘lLāhi wa lā ilāha illa ‘lLāhu wa ‘lLāhu akbar wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi ‘lLāhi ‘l-`aliyyi ‘l-`aẓīmi, Ḥasbiya ‘lLāhu wa ni`ma ‘l-Wakīl
en: Glory to Allah, Praise Allah, there is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest, there is neither Power nor Change but by Allah, Enough for me is Allah and the Best Guardian . [7 times]

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ نِ النُّوْرِ وَ أٰلِهٖ ـ مِائة مرّة
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadini ‘n-Nūri wa Ālihī
en: O Allah , send prayers upon our Master Muḥammad , the Light, and his Family! [100 times +]
blocks.review: مُحَمَّدِ نِ: tanwīn printed as a small nūn quṭnī with kasra below the gap; written as separate نِ (as on p045/p046).
